summary.name: Opera One
summary.one_liner: Opera One is a desktop web browser for Mac, Windows, and Linux that adds tab grouping, a built-in ad blocker, a sidebar with integrated apps and AI tools, and device sync.
use_cases: organize many browser tabs by task
block ads and trackers while working
keep music and messaging apps open beside web pages
use AI chat tools without opening new tabs
sync tabs and bookmarks between laptop and phone
share files and links between computer and phone
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Opera One as a browser that automatically groups tabs by context through Tab Islands and offers Workspaces to separate work, personal, and project sessions. It has a built-in Ad Blocker that blocks ads and trackers before they load, a Free VPN, and Video Skip for jumping past unwanted video content. A sidebar holds Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Translate, music apps such as Spotify and Apple Music, AI tools like Opera AI, ChatGPT and Gemini, and messengers such as WhatsApp, Slack and Discord. Opera Sync shares tabs, history, bookmarks and favorites across devices, and Opera Flow transfers files, links and notes between computer and phone without an account.
notable: Tab Islands automatically groups tabs by context
Sidebar integrates Gmail, Spotify, ChatGPT, WhatsApp and similar apps
Opera Flow shares files between computer and phone with no account needed
Built-in free ad blocker and free VPN
caveats: Page does not state a price for the ad blocker or VPN beyond calling them free; the Free VPN may have limits not described here
Phone support for Opera Flow and Sync is implied by the device references but iOS and Android are not explicitly named as download platforms on this page
Performance claim of up to 90% faster page opening is the vendor's own claim
